newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says 1997 inflation target within reach.
newsitem.headline: Manila says 1997 inflation target within reach.

text.p: Philippine central bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday the 1997 inflation target of six to seven percent set by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) was within reach.
Singson was speaking to reporters at a news conference.
On Wednesday, Singson said he projected a worst-case scenario of 8.5 percent average inflation this year after a de facto devaluation of the peso last Friday.
The government had earlier projected inflation to reach 5.2 to 5.7 percent this year.
Consumer inflation averaged 4.6 percent in the first half of the year.
